invariants.statement: All candidate runtime HTML, CSS, JavaScript, data, images, and API responses are same-origin; remote runtime requests and effects are zero.
acceptance_obligations: Browser network audit records zero non-loopback requests.

invariants.statement: Exactly 250 retained first-party product records preserve handle, vendor, type, variants, availability, price, and image provenance; every record is searchable and has a detail route.
acceptance_obligations: Catalog consistency test covers all 250 products.

invariants.statement: Cart ownership is bound to an opaque local session and unavailable variants cannot be added.
acceptance_obligations: Foreign-session cart reads and writes fail closed.

invariants.statement: Checkout accepts only opaque local-sandbox scenarios; amount, owner, USD currency, and fingerprint are server-derived and no payment credentials are accepted.
acceptance_obligations: Approved, declined, retryable, duplicate, stale, and foreign-owner outcomes are deterministic.

invariants.statement: No strict source-equivalence claim is made for populated cart, checkout, or payment because those source states are unavailable.
acceptance_obligations: Unavailable source states remain explicitly labeled clone-local.
